title: The dopamine neurotoxin 1-methyl-4-phenyl-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyridine (MPTP) produces histological lesions in the hypothalamus of the common marmoset.
abstract: The administration of 1-methyl-4-phenyl-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyridine (MPTP) to marmosets resulted in parkinsonism and degeneration of the substantia nigra pars compacta. Examination of the hypothalamus showed neuronophagic-like rosettes of glial cells and diffuse increase in glial numbers in areas of the dopaminergic A11-A14 groups. These findings suggest that MPTP may be toxic to dopamine neurons of the hypothalamus as well as to the substantia nigra.
